summary: Dossier layer: works.toml Gita entry + build_dossiers.py plan/generate + embed_summaries.py
description: Add Gita work entry to sources/works.toml (single work grouping the per-chapter sources — Agrippa/Transcendental Magic precedent). Then build_dossiers.py --plan CAUTION: plan mode writes the campaign freeze artifact — check docs/summary/implementation-guru.md first; if the current campaign is already generating, adding a work may require a NEW campaign id rather than a re-plan. Then --generate for the Gita work, then embed_summaries.py. DONE: dossier/summary rows exist for the Gita work; summary embeddings present; campaign decision documented in ticket.
